acceptance: Only a failure on the target update caused by Lucene's skip-index DocValues-update validation establishes reproduction. If the target succeeds, first confirm that _version_ exists and the in-place path was enabled.
correction: schema-docValuesSkipList.xml does not declare _version_. AtomicUpdateDocumentMerger.getInPlaceUpdatableFields returns an empty set when _version_ is absent or unsupported, which would turn the request into a full atomic update and hide the reported failure.
required_overlay_changes: In schema-docValuesSkipList.xml, add <field name="_version_" type="long" indexed="false" stored="false" docValues="true" multiValued="false" useDocValuesAsStored="true"/> before <uniqueKey>.
In DocValuesSkipListTest.beforeTests, enable solr.index.updatelog.enabled and load solrconfig.xml with schema-docValuesSkipList.xml.

The overlay must remain uncommitted. Before sending updates, verify the schema exposes _version_ and the longdv target as single-valued numeric DocValues fields eligible for in-place updates. Then use long_plain as the control and longdv as the skip-indexed target.
summary: Corrected the reproduction overlay setup: the custom schema also needs an in-place-capable _version_ field.
